subject.title: fix: preserve quoted replies in text sends

question: Should --reply-to-sender continue supporting unsynced group replies when the referenced message is absent from the local store?
rationale: Current documentation and main behavior support that workflow, while the PR deliberately fails missing quote targets to avoid silent unquoted delivery; choosing between compatibility and stricter correctness requires ownership of the public CLI contract.

options.title: Preserve the fallback
options.body: Use full stored quoted content when available, but retain the existing stanza-and-participant path for an explicit unsynced group sender.

options.title: Retire unsynced replies
options.body: Keep fail-closed validation, remove the documented fallback, and provide clear upgrade guidance explaining the intentional breaking change.

options.title: Pause the patch
options.body: Leave the current behavior unchanged until a supported WhatsApp representation for unsynced quoted content is established.

recommendation.title: Preserve the fallback
recommendation.body: Use full stored quoted content when available, but retain the existing stanza-and-participant path for an explicit unsynced group sender.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person as the current maintainer, and the decision affects the documented CLI and send/IPC compatibility contract.
